comment: Overrides for scripts/rust-notices.py: crates that publish no license text (or no license field) and code outside the crate graph. Every copyright line was checked against the upstream repository; canonical texts in spdx/ are SPDX License List v3.29.0. Where a crate offers several licenses and publishes none, Apache-2.0 is chosen because its text needs no copyright line. Target-specific entries print 'matched no crate' notes on other targets.

crates.name: alloc-stdlib
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; Cargo.toml says BSD-3-Clause; copyright lines from LICENSE at the root of github.com/dropbox/rust-alloc-no-stdlib, which holds this crate

crates.name: dlopen2
crates.reason: Linux only. Crate publishes no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; copyright lines from LICENSE in github.com/OpenByteDev/dlopen2 (no 0.8.2 tag; its holders match the crate's authors)

crates.name: fax
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; copyright line verbatim from LICENSE in github.com/pdf-rs/fax

crates.name: siphasher
crates.reason: The crate's COPYING only points at the MIT and Apache-2.0 texts it does not publish; MIT chosen; both copyright lines from that COPYING file (1.0.4 publishes the texts)

crates.name: libappindicator-sys
crates.reason: Linux only. Crate publishes no license file; 'Apache-2.0 OR MIT' per Cargo.toml; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: profiling
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' per Cargo.toml; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: zune-inflate
crates.reason: Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0 OR Zlib' per Cargo.toml; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: tauri-nspanel
crates.reason: macOS only. Git dependency without a license field; its repository root holds LICENSE_MIT and LICENSE_APACHE-2.0 (collected automatically) and its README says 'MIT or MIT/Apache 2.0'

crates.name: block
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate and github.com/SSheldon/rust-block publish no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; holder from the crate's authors

crates.name: malloc_buf
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate publishes no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; copyright line from LICENSE in github.com/SSheldon/malloc_buf

crates.name: objc-foundation
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate and github.com/SSheldon/rust-objc-foundation publish no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; holder from the crate's authors

crates.name: objc_id
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate and github.com/SSheldon/rust-objc-id publish no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; holder from the crate's authors

crates.name: objc2
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate publishes no license file; MIT per Cargo.toml and LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2; holder from the crate's authors and that repository's later LICENSE-MIT.txt

crates.name: objc2-encode
crates.reason: macOS only. As objc2: MIT-only per LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2; holder from the crate's authors

crates.name: objc2-foundation
crates.reason: macOS only. As objc2: MIT-only per LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2; holder from that repository's LICENSE-MIT.txt

crates.name: block2
crates.reason: macOS only. As objc2: MIT-only per LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2; holder from the crate's authors

crates.name: objc2-[acqw]*
crates.note: Generated from Apple SDK headers; see the 'Apple SDKs' section of LICENSE.md in github.com/madsmtm/objc2.
crates.reason: macOS only. objc2-app-kit, -cloud-kit, -core-*, -quartz-core and -web-kit publish no license file; all are 'Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT' per Cargo.toml and the upstream LICENSE.md; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: objc2-exception-helper
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate publishes no license file; 'Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT'; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: dispatch2
crates.reason: macOS only. Crate publishes no license file; 'Zlib OR Apache-2.0 OR MIT'; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: clipboard-win
crates.reason: Windows only. Crate publishes no license file; BSL-1.0 per Cargo.toml and LICENSE in github.com/DoumanAsh/clipboard-win, whose text has no copyright line

crates.name: webview2-com
crates.reason: Windows only. Crate publishes no license file; Cargo.toml says MIT; copyright line from LICENSE in github.com/wravery/webview2-rs

crates.name: webview2-com-sys
crates.reason: Windows only. As webview2-com. The crate also links Microsoft's prebuilt WebView2LoaderStatic.lib, listed under extra

crates.name: ndk
crates.reason: Android only. Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' per Cargo.toml; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: ndk-context
crates.reason: Android only. Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' per Cargo.toml; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: ndk-sys
crates.reason: Android only. Crate publishes no license file; 'MIT OR Apache-2.0' per Cargo.toml; Apache-2.0 chosen

crates.name: selectors
crates.reason: Android only (wry -> dom_query). Crate publishes no license file; MPL-2.0 per Cargo.toml. The Source Code Form line is generated from the crates.io source

extra.name: Microsoft WebView2 SDK loader (WebView2LoaderStatic.lib)
extra.reason: webview2-com-sys 0.39.1 statically links Microsoft's prebuilt WebView2LoaderStatic.lib (src/lib.rs, kind = "static") from the Microsoft.Web.WebView2 1.0.3800.47 NuGet package (WEBVIEW2_VERSION in its update-bindings tool). LICENSE.txt and NOTICE.txt are copied verbatim from that package (nupkg sha256 56c9f26bdd07916a2d1949fb58a5c7e434dfa1173577dca879206050c4e718db)
